title: Yayoi Kusama: All the Eternal Love I Have for the Pumpkins
description: Immersive mirrored installation of yellow polka-dotted pumpkins that appears to stretch into an infinite field, on view through Oct 18. Ticketed (online only); free for members, while general museum admission is always free.

title: Jack O'Lantern Glow at the Cincinnati Zoo
description: A half-mile after-hours trail of more than 6,000 hand-carved glowing pumpkins in 20+ themes at the zoo, running Oct 2-31 (closed Oct 5, 12, 19). Separate timed-entry ticket required; advance online purchase.

title: Donauschwaben Oktoberfest
description: 34th annual Bavarian festival with imported German beers on draft, pit-roasted pork and chicken, homemade sausage and strudel, live music, a 150-plus-person costume parade, dance performances and a kids' area. Sunday also hosts a car show from 10 AM to 3 PM.

title: Cincinnati Bengals vs. Jacksonville Jaguars
description: Week 4 NFL home game as the Bengals host the Jacksonville Jaguars on the riverfront, broadcast on CBS; the Jaguars visit Cincinnati for the second straight year.

title: Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra: Marsalis & Mussorgsky Reimagined
description: Conductor Cristian Macelaru leads the CSO with violinist Nicola Benedetti in Wynton Marsalis' Grammy-winning Violin Concerto, plus Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition in a Marsalis/Macelaru arrangement for the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra and CSO.

title: Holly Bowling: Solo Piano Reimagines the Grateful Dead
description: Pianist Holly Bowling blends classical technique with improvisational reworkings of Grateful Dead songs, in the historic Anderson Theater at Memorial Hall.

title: 60th Annual Hyde Park Square Art Show
description: Greater Cincinnati's largest one-day outdoor art show, with more than 200 artists showing painting, photography, sculpture, ceramics, glass and jewelry, plus live jazz, food and a youth art competition. Erie Ave is closed from Edwards to Michigan.

title: Keeneland Fall Meet: Fall Stars Weekend, Juddmonte Spinster Day
description: Keeneland's 90th Fall Meet continues with Sunday's Fall Stars Weekend card headlined by the $650,000 Grade 1 Juddmonte Spinster, plus the Castle & Key Bourbon (G2) and Indian Summer (G3); first post 1 PM.

title: St. James Court Art Show (70th Anniversary)
description: Juried fine-arts and crafts show with 600+ artists across four blocks of Victorian-era Old Louisville, ranked #3 best fine art show in the country by Sunshine Artist magazine; Sunday hours 10 AM to 5 PM.

title: Ohio Renaissance Festival: Viking Weekend
description: Viking Weekend at the 35-acre permanent Renaissance village, with jousting, music, crafts and more than a hundred daily performances across its stages.

title: Nancy Rexroth: Secrets of My Power (new retrospective)
description: First career retrospective of the photographer behind the 1977 photobook IOWA, opening Oct 2 and running to Jan 3, 2027. Free admission, with free parking at the museum.

title: LEGO Jurassic World: The Exhibition
venue: Cincinnati Museum Center at Union Terminal
description: Millions of LEGO bricks build life-size dinosaurs and scenes from the Jurassic World films inside the historic Union Terminal, open through Jan 4, 2027. On Sunday Oct 4 from 1-4 PM the museum hosts a Deaf Day in the exhibition.

title: Halloween Haunt at Kings Island
time: Check source (select Haunt nights; confirm on the park calendar)
description: Seven haunted mazes, four scare zones and four live shows after dark, plus daytime Tricks & Treats; new mazes include JASON: Blood Reign and Metal Massacre. Mazes require a Haunted Attractions Pass or bundle.

title: Fall Bonsai Show at Krohn Conservatory
description: The Bonsai Society of Greater Cincinnati shows specimen trees during Krohn's fall show, with club members and vendors on hand. Saturday 10 AM-2 PM features a styling demonstration by bonsai artist Jennifer Price; Sunday has consultations (sign-up required).

title: Taft Museum of Art (Sunday free admission)
description: A historic 1820 house museum with Old Master and American paintings, plus Taft Tourist: Sargents in Conversation (a Sargent portrait on loan from Tate Britain, through Oct 5) and Unfolding Elegance: European Fans. Admission is free on Sundays.

title: Contemporary Arts Center: SOFTlab and Sarah Rodriguez (last weekend)
description: SOFTlab's suspended color installation Gravity's Rainbow fills the lobby through Oct 31, while Sarah Rodriguez: Homespun, an archive of reclaimed objects exploring kinship, closes Oct 4. Free for members, ages 18 and under and SNAP/EBT holders.

title: Sunflower Festival at Gorman Heritage Farm
description: Cut-your-own sunflowers, a sunflower maze and corn maze, hayrides, pumpkins, farm animals, craft vendors and food trucks on a 122-acre working farm, rain or shine. A ticket is valid for one day only; no cash at the gate.

title: Fall Festival at Burger Farm & Garden Center
description: Weekend fall celebration at a family garden center in operation since 1904, with hayrides, a pumpkin patch and outdoor games, plus mums, cornstalks, pumpkins and gourds for sale. Runs weekends Oct 3-4, 10-11, 17-18 and 24-25.

title: Fall Season at Niederman Family Farm
address: 5110 Lesourdsville West Chester Rd, Liberty Twp, OH 45011
description: Pick a pumpkin, wind through the corn maze, take a tractor ride and let kids burn off energy on the jumping pillow and play areas, with farm animals and outdoor games. Open Sept 25 through Nov 1.

title: TALK (world premiere) at the Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park
venue: Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park, Rosenthal Shelterhouse Theatre
description: Cincinnati native Theresa Rebeck's world premiere, a satire of the news-talk media in which a live broadcast spirals out of control when an unexpected guest joins the panel. Runs Sept 26-Oct 25; Saturday also has free Made in Cincy new-works readings (reservation required).

title: HEIST at the Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park
venue: Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park, Moe and Jack's Place - The Rouse Theatre
description: A high-tech theatrical caper full of lasers, aerial stunts, clever twists and suspense by Arun Lakra, directed by Blake Robison, running Sept 12-Oct 11. Sunday's 2 PM matinee is the ASL-signed performance.

title: Art on Vine (Bengals tailgate edition)
description: Final summer residency of the free, family-friendly market with 80+ local artists and handmade-goods makers, food trucks and refreshments, doubling as a Bengals tailgate celebration. Organizers recommend taking the free Cincinnati Streetcar.

title: Underwater Pumpkin GLOW at Newport Aquarium
description: Giant glowing pumpkin sculptures and underwater jack-o-lanterns turn the exhibits into reefs, including a 10-foot Giant Pacific Octopus made of pumpkins. Included with general admission; pumpkin decorating is available for an extra cost.

title: Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis
description: The Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra closes the Cincinnati Symphony's season-opening festival with its own concert at Music Hall; the CSO itself does not perform on this program.

title: Don Lemon & DL Hughley: DL + DL 'Anything Goes'
description: Journalist Don Lemon and comedian D.L. Hughley bring their live conversation-and-comedy tour to the Taft Theatre; doors at 6 PM, with metal-detector screening and bag inspection at entry.

title: Brad Williams: The Tall Tales Tour
description: High-energy stand-up comedian Brad Williams brings his Tall Tales Tour 2026 to the Taft Theatre; doors at 6:30 PM.

title: Who Dey Brunch at Rhinegeist Rooftop
description: Bengals game-day brunch on the Rhinegeist rooftop with early access, a chef-curated buffet, mimosas and beer for adults; event runs 10 AM to noon and tickets are limited.

title: Findlay Market Sunday Farmers Market
description: Ohio's oldest continuously operated public market is open Sundays 10 AM to 4 PM, with the farmers market 10 AM to 2 PM alongside 50+ merchants selling produce, meats, specialty foods and flowers.

title: Hyde Park Farmers' Market
description: Sunday farmers' market on Hyde Park Square, 9:30 AM to 1 PM, with weekly produce updates; the season runs May through October.

title: Cincinnati Art Week: Opening Weekend
address: Kickoff at 1600 Race Street, Cincinnati, OH 45202
description: Week-long celebration of art and creative community in Over-the-Rhine with exhibition openings, pop-up galleries, artist talks and workshops across 10+ spaces.

title: MAMMOTH Music & Arts Fest
description: All-ages music and arts festival across the multi-room Southgate House Revival in Newport, with doors at 11 AM and a show start at noon.

title: Kevin Nealon at Go Bananas Comedy Club
description: Actor and Saturday Night Live alum Kevin Nealon performs stand-up at Cincinnati's long-running comedy club; the 7:30 PM show is sold out so only the 9:45 PM show is listed.

title: Lyfe Jennings at Bogart's
description: R&B singer-songwriter Lyfe Jennings plays Bogart's, Cincinnati's historic Vine Street music venue, on Saturday night.

title: Thomas More Saints Homecoming vs. #25 Walsh
venue: Republic Bank Field, Thomas More University
address: 333 Thomas More Parkway, Crestview Hills, KY 41017
description: Thomas More hosts #25 Walsh University in a G-MAC conference football game on Homecoming night under the lights; streamed on FloCollege.

title: AEW Collision
address: 500 Louie B. Nunn Drive, Highland Heights, KY 41099
description: All Elite Wrestling brings its Collision show to Truist Arena at Northern Kentucky University on Saturday night.

title: Columbus Blue Jackets vs. Utah Mammoth
description: Blue Jackets opening-week home game with a free Plaza Party from 4 PM until puck drop, doors at 5:30 PM, and a Zach Werenski Norris Trophy T-shirt for the first 10,000 fans.

title: OMNIMAX Theater: Arctic: Our Frozen Planet
venue: Cincinnati Museum Center, Robert D. Lindner Family OMNIMAX Theater
description: Giant-dome OMNIMAX film following a year at the top of the world; the theater also screens T. Rex and other titles. Museum Center is open daily 10 AM to 5 PM.

title: Cincinnati Nature Center at Rowe Woods: trails, visitor center and Nature PlayScape
time: Grounds 8:00 AM–7:00 PM; Visitor Center 9:00 AM–5:00 PM
priceLabel: $12 adult / $10 senior-military / $8 child (3 and under free)
description: Rowe Woods has about 20 miles of trails through old-growth forest, plus a Nature PlayScape, pollinator garden, raptor ambassadors and a visitor center with a nature shop. Open seven days a week.

title: BB Riverboats High Noon Sightseeing Cruise on the Ohio River
description: A two-hour Ohio River cruise with a banjo player sharing river lore, plus a cash bar and snack bar. General admission seating on the outside of the vessel; interior seats are reserved for diners.

title: BB Riverboats Evening Skyline Cruises on the Ohio River

times.2026-10-03: 7:00 PM–9:00 PM (boarding 6:00 PM), Music and Skyline Cruise, $40
times.2026-10-04: 6:30 PM–8:30 PM (boarding 6:00 PM), Early Evening Sightseeing Cruise, $36

description: Two-hour evening sightseeing cruises past the Cincinnati skyline with DJ entertainment, a cash bar and snack bar; Saturday's Music and Skyline cruise sails at sunset. Outdoor seating only.

title: Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden daytime: Sunday cheetah encounters, Safari Train and giraffe feeding
description: Daytime zoo visit with Cheetah Encounters at 10:30 AM and 12 PM on Sundays, giraffe feeding (), Safari Train () and carousel () rides, and a free-flight aviary. Separate from the evening Jack O'Lantern Glow.

title: Fifth & Vine Live: Repertoire on Fountain Square
description: Fountain Square's Saturday-night Fifth & Vine Live series brings a regional cover and tribute band, Repertoire, to the downtown square; free, no tickets required.

title: Fountain District Fanfest: Overtime
description: Post-game Bengals celebration on Fountain Square with live music from Jet Pack Academy, cornhole and drink specials after the Jaguars game.

title: American Sign Museum
description: A one-of-a-kind collection of more than a century of American signs, from gilded glass to glowing neon, displayed along a recreated Main Street.

title: Pyramid Hill Sculpture Park & Museum
description: Drive, walk or rent an art cart through hundreds of acres of hills and woods dotted with monumental outdoor sculpture, a strong early-fall outing.

title: Meet a Meteorite at the Cincinnati Observatory
description: An evening program at the historic Cincinnati Observatory built around real meteorites, with registration through the Observatory's booking page.

title: The Land of Illusion Haunted Scream Park
description: One of the region's biggest haunt parks, with multiple haunted attractions and scare zones open Friday and Saturday nights through Halloween.
